chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Hishām ibn al-Ḥakam, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

While the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله was in al-Masjid al-Haram and he was wearing new clothes, the polytheists threw the stomach contents of a she-camel upon him, filling his clothes with it. That affected him as Allah willed. Then he went to Abū Ṭālib and said to him, “O my uncle, how do you regard my standing among you?” He said to him, “What is that, O son of my brother?” So he informed him of the matter.

Then Abū Ṭālib called Ḥamzah, took the sword, and said to Ḥamzah, “Take the stomach contents.” Then he headed toward the people, and the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله was with him. He came to Quraysh while they were around the Kaʿbah, and when they saw him, they recognized anger in his face. Then he said to Ḥamzah, “Smear the stomach contents upon their moustaches.” So he did that until he had reached the last of them.
Then Abū Ṭālib turned to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله and said, “O son of my brother, this is your standing among us.”

key_terms.الْكَعْبَةِ: the Kaʿbah, around which Quraysh were gathered
key_terms.الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ: the Sacred Mosque in Mecca, the setting of the incident
key_terms.الْمُشْرِكُونَ: the polytheists who committed the insult against the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.حَسَبِي: my standing, lineage, or noble regard among my people
key_terms.سَلَى نَاقَةٍ: the stomach contents or afterbirth of a she-camel thrown upon the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.سِبَالِهِمْ: their moustaches, upon which the filth was smeared
key_terms.قُرَيْشًا: the Quraysh, the Meccan tribe gathered around the Kaʿbah

ai.seo_question: How did Abū Ṭālib respond when Quraysh humiliated the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله in al-Masjid al-Haram?
ai.summary: This narration recounts an incident in which the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله was insulted by the polytheists in al-Masjid al-Haram, after which he informed Abū Ṭālib of what had happened. Abū Ṭālib responded decisively, confronting Quraysh and demonstrating his protection and support for the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله. The report highlights the hostility of the مشرکون and the familial defense extended to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله in the early Meccan period.
